Fiery ShootingBasicExclusive Lv.2
Deals 2 stages of 80% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, with a 60% chance to inflict a layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns.
High-Performance Pistol Lv.2Ahn Hee Jin has extra 8% Effect Hit: Each stage of Fiery Shooting additionally shoots a bullet to a random enemy apart from the main target. This bullet will prioritize a different enemy. Ahn Hee Jin will not additionally shoot the bullet if there is only 1 enemy.
Burst of GunfireActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 4 stages of 80% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, with a 60% chance to inflict a layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns.
High-Performance Pistol Lv.3Burst of Gunfire deals extra 2 stages of ATK DMG. If Burst of Gunfire didn't kill any enemy in its duration, Ahn Hee Jin will gain 1 layer of [Magic Warhead] for 2 turns, and the CD of Burst of Gunfire will be reduced by 1 turn. [Magic Warhead]: Increases DMG dealt by Burning Bullet by 50%.
Burning BulletPassiveExclusive Lv.3
Reduces [HP Burning] DMG inflicted by Ahn Hee Jin to 60% of its initial value, but there is a 100% chance to inflict 2 layers of [HP Burning] instead when Ahn Hee Jin inflicts 1 layer of [HP Burning] each time. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES. If Ahn Hee Jin successfully inflicts 1 layer of [HP Burning] on the target with 5 layers of [HP Burning], she will deal extra 1 stage of 2.4% DMG of the target's Max HP, each stage caps at 7.2% of Ahn Hee Jin's Max HP. This extra DMG is considered as [HP Burning] DMG and Skill DMG.
High-Performance Pistol Lv.3Burst of Gunfire deals extra 2 stages of ATK DMG.
